mapper.select: SELECT DIMENSION_ID as id, DIMENSION_NAME as label, DIMENSION_CODE as code, DIMENSION_TYPE as type, PARENT_ID as parentId, SORT_ORDER as sortOrder, IS_REQUIRED as isRequired FROM TBL_BUDGET_DIMENSION WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC
SELECT ATTRIBUTE_ID as id, ATTRIBUTE_NAME as name, ATTRIBUTE_VALUE as value, ATTRIBUTE_TYPE as type FROM TBL_BUDGET_DIMENSION_ATTRIBUTE WHERE DIMENSION_ID = #{dimensionId} AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT RELATION_ID as id, SOURCE_DIMENSION_ID as sourceDimensionId, TARGET_DIMENSION_ID as targetDimensionId, RELATION_TYPE as relationType FROM TBL_BUDGET_DIMENSION_RELATION WHERE SOURCE_DIMENSION_ID = #{dimensionId} OR TARGET_DIMENSION_ID = #{dimensionId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
